verdict.rationale: GitLab's marketing docs claim that agents can 'turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities' and that SCA/dependency scanning findings surface directly in merge requests, implying an automated remediation-MR workflow similar to a dependency-update bot. However, there is no detailed documentation of an automatic 'create MR to bump vulnerable dependency version' feature (e.g., no equivalent to Dependabot's auto-PR flow) and no independent/hands-on verification of this specific capability. missing for 10: concrete docs on auto-generated dependency-bump merge requests, hands-on/community confirmation that these MRs are created automatically, and details on trigger frequency/scope.
